title: Evidence of much wider distribution of the potential West Nile virus vector, Culex modestus, in the UK
citation: Abbott, A.J., Gardner, B.L., Hardy, H. et al. Evidence of much wider distribution of the potential West Nile virus vector, Culex modestus, in the UK. Parasites Vectors 18, 482 (2025).
sampling_method: larval dip
description: Surveillance was conducted using Mosquito Magnet and BG-Pro traps baited with synthetic lures between June and October 2024, supplemented by field sampling for immature stages. Populations were detected at two new localities in Cambridgeshire (Ouse Fen, Fowlmere) and on the Sussex/Hampshire border (Pagham Harbour, Farlington Marshes), with high abundances in some localities. The presence of Cx. modestus at new locations suggests ongoing range expansion in the UK.
remarks_comments: Dates are estimated based on week number provided in paper
